reviews.name: Rippling Recruiting
reviews.note: Founding year not on the About page. Recruiting page describes posting to job boards and HRIS flows, but no statement of how jobs get in. Developer page gives self-serve API tokens; no recruiting-specific API stated. Browser run was not blocked. Quotes come from the fetch tool's text and were not re-checked against raw text.

reviews.name: Resume Genius
reviews.note: Founding year 2009 on About page. About page lists Resume Genius, Taipei, Taiwan (R.O.C.) for the marketing office and a Lucerne address for business operations, with no stated headquarters. Pricing page is for job seekers only. Language selector not on the homepage; other-language sites sit on cvgenius.com, off domain. Headless reader hit a Cloudflare challenge on /about; not solved.

reviews.name: GovernmentJobs.com
reviews.note: Company Info gives headquarters in El Segundo, CA, United States and owner Governmentjobs.com, Inc. (DBA NEOGOV). Page says the company began developing applications in 1998, which is not a stated founding year.

reviews.name: Workday Recruiting
reviews.note: Our Story says Workday was founded by Aneel Bhusri and Dave Duffield, and a summary gives 2005, but the year was not in a quotable sentence; the captured quote was cut off before the year, so founded is not recorded. No parent or owner named. Language list taken from the country and region chooser.

reviews.name: Australian Bureau of Statistics
reviews.note: About page gives only a description of the agency. Welcome page and homepage state none of the three fields. The corporate-information guess returned 404. Browser run not needed.

reviews.name: Jobvite
reviews.note: Pricing page is modular and quote-based with no prices. Founding year not stated on pricing, Employ company, or news pages. Those pages name Employ, Inc. as owner of the brands; parent was not requested.

reviews.name: Rikunabi
reviews.note: Recruit group company page (recruit.co.jp, off domain) gives Recruit Co., Ltd. founded 2012 as a spin-off, but that is not on the entry's own domain, so it is not recorded. Data-use page covers user data to employers, not job intake. Help center rendered empty in headless reader. Recruit page was fetched after a 403 through the headless reader.

reviews.name: RECRUIT AGENT
reviews.note: Business page fee wording was read with the fetch tool and is recorded. Headless reader run on /business/ returned a 503 maintenance page marked blocked, so the verification pass is recorded as blocked. Service page links back to the business page and gives no fee terms.
